description: This file contains Redux action creators and utility functions for managing channel-related interactions in the Mattermost web application, including channel switching, user typing events, logout, and navigation logic.

methods.name: emitChannelClickEvent
methods.description: Handles channel click events, switching channels, updating UI state, and fetching relevant data.

methods.name: setLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Sets the last unread status for a channel based on message counts and user membership.

methods.name: clearLastUnreadChannel
methods.description: Clears the last unread channel indicator.

methods.name: updateNewMessagesAtInChannel
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last message viewed in a channel.

methods.name: showMobileSubMenuModal
methods.description: Displays a modal with submenu options on mobile.

methods.name: sendEphemeralPost
methods.description: Sends a temporary, ephemeral post message to a channel.

methods.name: sendAddToChannelEphemeralPost
methods.description: Sends an ephemeral post indicating a user was added to a channel.

methods.name: emitLocalUserTypingEvent
methods.description: Notifies the server that the local user is typing in a channel.

methods.name: emitUserLoggedOutEvent
methods.description: Handles user logout process, including cleanup and navigation.

methods.name: emitBrowserFocus
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating browser window focus change.

methods.name: getTeamRedirectChannelIfIsAccesible
methods.description: Retrieves an accessible redirect channel for a team, considering previous user activity.

methods.name: redirectUserToDefaultTeam
methods.description: Redirects the user to their default or most relevant team and channel based on their state and preferences.
